This head selectively focuses on DNA binding motives and transcription factors that suggest a complex interplay of regulatory functions, favoring CRC and STAT domain factors, while showing a clear avoidance of basic helix-loop-helix factors and SAND domain factors.
layer11-head11:
Head Name: CRC and Transcription Factor Modulation

This head selectively focuses on sequences associated with the CRC domain and modulates attention towards multiple transcription factors, including ARID and MADS box factors, while decreasing focus on basic helix-loop-helix factors and several others, signaling a complex engagement with transcriptional regulation elements.
